subject: Human Evolution
title: What Is an Ice Age?
description: Learn What Is an Ice Age? in one minute.

hook.text: Ice ages aren't rare events. Earth has cycled through dozens in the past three million years.

buildup.text: Milankovitch cycles—wobbles in Earth's orbit—shift how much sunlight hits the poles over millennia.

discovery.text: When summer sun weakens, winter snow survives year-round. Ice sheets grow, sea levels drop by 120 meters.

twist.text: We live in an interglacial right now. The ice age isn't over—we're just in a warm pause.

climax.text: Humans evolved during these wild swings. Climate instability, not stability, shaped our species.

punchline.text: We're children of climate chaos, not calm.

quiz.question: What drives ice age cycles?
options: Changes in Earth's orbital patterns (Milankovitch cycles)
